title: A Framework to Assess Multilingual Vulnerabilities of LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It focused on multilingual vulnerabilities to jailbreaking prompts concerning illegal activities, harmful content, privacy violations, adult content, political campaigning, and fraudulent activities.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
